example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মিঠেমুখের কারণে সকলে তাকে পছন্দ করে।
মিঠেমুখে কথা বললে সমস্যা সহজে সমাধান হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone likes him because of his sweet mouth.
Problems are easily solved when speaking with a sweet mouth.
note: Refers to someone who speaks in a pleasant, endearing manner, often implying gentle persuasion.
